ask_doctor: Ask Doctor Temporary mild stinging may appear after use and usually fades quickly on its own.If stinging lasts long, eye discharge increases abnormally or you have obvious discomfort, stop use right away and consult a healthcare provider promptly.
do_not_use: Do not use if solution changes color or becomes cloudy
dosage_and_administration: Directions Use 8 to 10 times per day. Made from pure plant extracts, suitable for long-term use. Finish within 10 days after opening. Not intended for inflammatory eye conditions.
inactive_ingredient: Inactive ingredients Angelica Sinensis Root Extract,Cassia Obtusifolia Seed Extract,Clematis Chinensis Root Extract,Alpinia Officinarum Rhizome, Magnolia Liliflora Flower Extract.
indications_and_usage: Uses For daily eye care of people with eye discomfort caused by excessive eye use, eye fatigue,dryness, itching, soreness,distending pain, and mild eye irritation-induced redness.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep Out Of Reach Of Children Keep this product out of reach of children and pets.
